requirement.source: README deterministic policy and POST exports
requirement.summary: Captured revision, exact JSONL and CSV bytes, section order, and side-effect-free invalid requests.

requirement.source: README lifecycle and cancel
requirement.summary: Legal Export terminal transitions, stable cancel replay, and no terminal duplication.

requirement.source: README Download Grants and byte ranges
requirement.summary: Grant lifecycle, immutable ETag, exact single ranges, and non-leaking failures.

requirement.source: README retention cleanup and Deletion Proof
requirement.summary: Only unreachable expired objects delete and every deletion has exactly one proof and event.

requirement.source: T16 sharded export manifests
requirement.summary: Stable non-crossing shard plan, all-verified Manifest, and target-specific grants.

requirement.source: README object and section digests plus T16 manifest digest
requirement.summary: Independent byte oracle closes section, object, shard, and manifest digests.

requirement.source: README active dedupe and durable idempotency
requirement.summary: Concurrent equivalent requests and unknown responses produce one durable Export plan and response.

requirement.source: README cancellation race and atomic publication
requirement.summary: Publish and cancel linearize to one complete legal terminal outcome.

requirement.source: README grant and cleanup invariants
requirement.summary: Grant creation, revoke, expiry, and cleanup linearize without deleting protected bytes.

requirement.source: T16 shard verification and aggregate publication
requirement.summary: Fan-out effects occur once and Manifest publication is all-or-none.

requirement.source: README Work lease fencing and barriers
requirement.summary: SIGKILL after claim recovers one generation operation and fences the stale owner.

requirement.source: README staged object atomic publication
requirement.summary: SIGKILL around effect completion never exposes staged or incomplete bytes.

requirement.source: README cleanup Work, proof, and barriers
requirement.summary: Cleanup recovers across delete and commit windows with one proof and no live deletion.

requirement.source: README exact events and dispatcher barrier
requirement.summary: Outbox retries preserve identity, body, and sequence through unknown acknowledgement.

requirement.source: README Real UI
requirement.summary: Production Chromium completes visible legacy Export, Grant, Range, and revoke flows.

requirement.source: T16 real UI sharded export
requirement.summary: Production Chromium shows ordered shard progress and downloads selected immutable targets.

requirement.source: README OpenAPI snapshot and T16 FINAL union
requirement.summary: Runtime, OpenAPI, and point-in-time snapshot expose exact FINAL contracts and sorts.

requirement.source: README audit and verification invariants
requirement.summary: Public identifiers and digests trace each request through bytes, events, and deletion proof.

requirement.source: T16 V1 migration and legacy rules
requirement.summary: Populated V1 bytes, grants, pending Work, events, and saved replays survive FINAL exactly.

requirement.source: README formal range-download scenario
requirement.summary: One hundred clients sustain at least 150 MiB per second for sixty seconds with exact ranges.

requirement.source: README formal five-million-record-generation scenario
requirement.summary: Two workers generate and verify five million ordered records within one hundred twenty seconds.

requirement.source: README formal expired-object-cleanup scenario
requirement.summary: Two workers delete exactly ten thousand expired objects within sixty seconds while preserving one thousand controls.
